text:
Nora: Quick sync — Orbit beta enroll window opens next Tue. Need final list + a lightweight feedback plan. Goal: 3 waves, 100 seats, no more than 30 AE-owned seats.

Diego: I can export the enroll CSV. Which columns do you want? email,company,owner,seat_count,timezone,renewal_tag?

Nora: yes to all + field 'pre_survey_use_case'. Also add flags: orbit_flag,vip_support.

Lin: Can we gate invites by vip_support so AE-owned accounts get a different template?

Harper: Yep — two templates: orbit-standard and orbit-vip. Ill wire invite routing. Also suggest micro-NPS on day 5 and a 2-week product checklist.

Nora: Good. Owners: @Diego = enrollment CSV, @Harper = invite templates + routing, @Lin = survey copy + in-app modal.

InviteBot: Scheduled job "orbit-invite-batch" will run 2026-04-13T14:00Z. Throttle: 25/hr/region.

Diego: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood.co/orbit/enrollments_final.csv (98 rows). Noted timezone skew to CET.

Lin: Draft survey copy pasted here: 
"Day 5 NPS: "How likely are you to recommend Redwood (0-10)?" + "What’s one thing missing?"

Harper: For risky renewals, tag renewal_30/renewal_90. If renewal_30 and low pre_survey_score, route to AE for high-touch kickoff within 3 days.

Nora: Good call. Also: instrument first_successful_call and first_vector_store_create events so CS can see early traction. Engineering ok with quick hooks?

Diego: I pinged eng; they said they can add event webhooks by EOD.

Nora: Final check: if any corporate invite bounces, move that account to manual AE invite and delay seat assignment. Any blockers?

Harper: None from my side. I'll post templates and a short runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.co/orbit/invite-playbook.md

Nora: Thanks. Quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. If anything urgent, DM me. :rocket:
